evals.name: feature-install-failure
evals.prompt:
My devcontainer build is failing with this error:

```
[2024-01-15T10:30:00.123Z] ERROR: Feature 'ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1' failed to install
[2024-01-15T10:30:00.124Z] Exit code 1
[2024-01-15T10:30:00.125Z] npm ERR! code ENOENT
[2024-01-15T10:30:00.126Z] npm ERR! syscall open
[2024-01-15T10:30:00.127Z] npm ERR! path /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/package.json
```

What's wrong and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis identifying the issue (likely Node/npm installation conflict or missing package) with specific fix steps.
assertions: Identifies the error type (feature installation failure)

evals.name: permission-denied-error
evals.prompt:
My container won't start. I see this in the logs:

```
[2024-01-15T09:15:00.456Z] Start: Run: docker compose...
[2024-01-15T09:15:00.789Z] permission denied while trying to connect to Docker daemon
[2024-01-15T09:15:00.790Z] at /var/run/docker.sock
```
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis of Docker permission issue with specific remediation steps.
assertions: Suggests checking user group membership (docker group)
Mentions needing to log out and back in
